notes.title: Syder Reloaded Update 1
notes.notes:
We just released an update for Syder Reloaded to address some important features that were missing or incomplete in our initial release.

Added support for V-Sync. Check out the options menu.

Added support for Steam Cloud saves

Fixed a soft-lock bug in the logic of the fourth level of the campaign (Unfinished Business).

Fixed a minor issue that could cause a soft lock at the end of the Lighthouse Survival level.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

Have fun, Starfighters!

notes.title: Today is Release Day: Syder Reloaded is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello Syder pilots! Almost exactly 13 years after the release of Syder Arcade, the remastered version of Studio Evil's first title is now available on Steam! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870175/b451ab0e439dae214c17a3cf9d1a5b82503f3b71.png

This is not just a new edition, it's a brand new game! Compared to the original title, this is what you can find in Syder Reloaded:

 New and improved graphics
 The classic ships have been rebalanced
 We added 4 new playable ships
 Improved online leaderboards
 Improved storytelling, better dialogues and brand new opening and and ending cinematics
 New alternative anime character portraits
 New enemies
 A new boss fight!
 Improved levels, some of hem have been rebuilt from the ground-up!
 Redesigned powerup and special weapon systems
 New score system with combos, grazing and bullet cancelling!

We want to thank our community for the unstoppable support (and the incredible patience) we have seen during these years. For you who already own Syder Arcade, you can benefit from the dedicated Syder Bundle, which will allow you to purchase Syder Reloaded with a special 60% discount for the first month after release.

You can also find Syder Reloaded available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. We have partnered with Strictly Limited to offer a retail limited version for console, which we are very thankful for.

Also, don't forget to join our Discord server!

Enjoy your space adventure and good luck!
